race.comment: CATHAY EXPRESS (10) showed talent in her first campaign earlier in the year, and she resumes from a spell with a recent trial win under her belt. The bar plates going on her front hooves is always a query, but any market confidence would be worth following. ARTFUL MAXIMUS (1) resumes from a spell as a gelding for the first time, and now that his mind is firmly focused on racing, he should be an each-way threat, especially with the blinkers on for the first time. GLOCK 'N' ROLL (6) gave a good sight for a long way fresh up at Halidon 12 days ago, and he may try similar front-running tactics here from a good gate. Stick with him. BEWITCHING MISSY (9) resumes from a spell, and her tune-up trials have been good enough. Follow any market confidence. HELLENIC STAR (14) resumes fresh up for the in-form Jessica Tzaferis stable, and he can give this a big shake.
